Authors note high variability in rabbit plasmin-generation (PG) curves.
direction: evidence does not favour the model

summary: Oreff et al. 2021: Sheep tenocyte gene-expression and proliferation match human responses mainly under constant inflammation (Mahalanobis 8.94; proliferation slope diff -0.0878, p=0.009) but are less similar when healthy (Mahalanobis 24.78) and only borderline under transient inflammation. Data are from three biological replicates per species.
why_range_is_wide: Similarity varies by inflammatory condition: sheep are least similar when healthy and most similar under constant inflammation.

summary: Evidence is mixed: Daluwatumulle et al. 2026 found model robustness scores 31–85% across cancers (e.g. bladder 85.05%, pediatric glioma 79.88%), but Petersen‑Jones et al. 2015 reported dogs regained ERG/function close to normal while human patients showed no ERG change.
why_range_is_wide: Range reflects large variation across cancer types, pediatric vs adult cohorts and inclusion of negative-control cancers.
negative_controls: Negative controls ACC and LAML had low scores (adult ACC 31.1%; adult leukemia/LAML 40.31%).
